eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 International Conference on Emerging Materials, Measurement Technologies and Machine Intelligence (EM3I)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Components, Circuits, Devices and Systems; Computing and Processing; Engineered Materials, Dielectrics and Plasmas; Fields, Waves and Electromagnetics; Geoscience; Photonics and Electrooptics; Robotics and Control Systems; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.keywords: Emerging materials,Nanomaterials,Smart materials,Instrumentation and measurement,Sensors And Actuators,Machine intelligence,Artificial intelligence,Machine Learning,
eventDetail.scope: The conference covers research and developments in emerging and advanced materials, innovative measurement and instrumentation technologies, and machine intelligence methods that enable next-generation engineering systems. The scope includes nanomaterials, functional materials, electronic and photonic devices, sensing and metrology techniques, data acquisition and signal processing, as well as AI/ML approaches for materials discovery, device optimisation and intelligent measurement. EM3I provides a platform for integrating materials science, instrumentation and computational intelligence to advance smart, efficient and adaptive technologies across scientific and industrial domains.
